NOTE: extracted8/ already holds a transcription of the same paper from the Udvash question-bank book under the plain filename ju-d-2017-2018-set1.json; this Drive-PDF transcription is kept under the '-drivepdf' filename so neither overwrites the other — the two are independent renderings of the same paper for cross-verification. EXTRACTION STAGE: all questions content-UNVERIFIED and all keyed answers answer-UNVERIFIED; the printed compilation keys are preserved as-is (including two key boxes, Q63 and Q67, that contradict the compilation's own printed explanations — see ANSWERS.md/EXTRACTION_NOTES.md) and are NOT official JU keys. Printed 'no correct option' disposition at Q55 encoded per validator convention (answerVerificationStatus 'verified' for that item only). sourceDocuments.title: JU D Unit admission test 2017-2018, Set Code 1 — solved-paper scan (AdmissionWar / Google Drive)
sourceDocuments.notes: Scanned solved-paper reprint distributed via admissionwar.com (Google Drive file id 1ESY38KZ2PVZ34Svrv5ct_ITfZqY4sp0I), 6 pages, CamScanner scan. Printed header (p.1): '১ম বর্ষ স্নাতক (সম্মান) ভর্তি পরীক্ষা ২০১৭-২০১৮', 'D ইউনিট, জীববিজ্ঞান, জাহাঙ্গীরনগর বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়', 'SET CODE: 1', 'সময়ঃ ৬০ মিনিট, পূর্ণমানঃ ৮০', '(প্রতিটি ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.২০ নম্বর কাটা যাবে। প্রশ্নপত্রে উত্তর চিহ্নিত করা যাবে না)' and two OMR practice sentences (ক) আমার ভাইয়ের রক্তে রাঙানো একুশে ফেব্রুয়ারি; খ) Smoking is injurious to health). The printed SET CODE 1 matches the listing label Set-1. Key form: a printed boxed 'Ans-A/B/C/D' beside each question (Q55 instead prints 'সঠিক উত্তর নেই।'), plus printed ব্যাখ্যা boxes for most questions; red/green pen ticks, circles and underlines on the scan are a reader's hand marks, NOT keys, and were ignored. Page footers 'For More Question Bank Visit…', 'Visit www.admissionwar.com' and 'Scanned by CamScanner' are aggregator marks, not paper content. Transcription by direct visual reading of 300-dpi page renders (quarter-page crops; zoomed re-reads for Q2(c), Q4, Q5, Q33, Q55, Q63, Q64, Q79, Q80). Composition: Bangla 4 (Q1-4), English 4 (Q5-8), IQ 1 (Q9), General Mathematics 3 (Q10-12), Biology 44 (Q13-34 Zoology, Q35-56 Botany; printed as one continuous run with no section headings — the split is by content and matches Satt Academy's Set-1 bank composition), Chemistry 24 (Q57-80). Mathematical notation linearised (^ for superscripts, a/b for fractions, √; chemical subscripts as plain digits, e.g. H2SO4; nuclides as ^mass_atomic, e.g. ^14_6C).
